searchTerms.title: 🔍 What businesses to target
searchTerms.description: Business types as you would search Google Maps, e.g. "dentist", "roofing contractor", "law firm".

locations.title: 📍 Locations
locations.description: Any city, region or postal code, e.g. "Toronto, ON, Canada", "Austin, TX", "Salt Lake, Kolkata". Each location is one Google Maps Scraper run.

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max businesses per search term
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Passed to Google Maps Scraper as maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch. Google Maps Scraper automatically splits big areas, so large numbers work.

websiteFilter.title: Website filter
websiteFilter.description: Only businesses with a website (SEO/PPC pitches) or only without one (web-development pitches).

scrapeContacts.title: Find emails & socials (Google Maps Scraper add-on)
scrapeContacts.description: Google Maps Scraper's 'Company contacts enrichment' — visits each website for emails and social profiles. Billed by Google Maps Scraper.

ownerEnrichmentPerPlace.title: Owner / decision-maker records per business
ownerEnrichmentPerPlace.description: Google Maps Scraper's 'Business leads enrichment' add-on: employee names, job titles, work emails, LinkedIn. 0 = off. This add-on is charged per record by Apify — start with 1–2.

leadsEnrichmentDepartments.title: Decision-maker departments (optional)
leadsEnrichmentDepartments.description: Filter for the leads add-on, using the department values Google Maps Scraper accepts (e.g. "c_suite"). Leave empty for no filter — this actor already ranks Owner/Founder/CEO first.

useContactDetailsScraper.title: Deep email search with Contact Details Scraper
useContactDetailsScraper.description: For businesses that still have no email, runs Apify's Contact Details Scraper (vdrmota/contact-info-scraper) across their site.

contactScraperMaxPagesPerSite.title: Contact Details Scraper: pages per site

auditWebsites.title: Audit websites & look for owner names
auditWebsites.description: Cheap HTTP check of each website: HTTPS, mobile, meta tags, Google Ads/Analytics/Meta Pixel, outdated footer — plus owner/founder names from About/Team pages. Powers the lead score and pitch angles.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only save leads that have an email

onlyWithoutWebsite.title: Only save businesses WITHOUT a website

maxRating.title: Only businesses rated at or below

mapsScraperExtraInput.title: Extra Google Maps Scraper input (advanced)
mapsScraperExtraInput.description: Any extra fields passed straight to compass/crawler-google-places, e.g. {"countryCode":"ca", "categoryFilterWords":["dentist"]}. Overrides the fields above.
